name: Instrumentation Engineering Practice Mock - Chapter Test

questions.question: Which sensor is commonly used to measure temperature?
questions.hint: Resistance Temperature Detectors (RTD) change resistance predictably with temperature.

questions.question: What is the working principle of LVDT?
questions.hint: Linear Variable Differential Transformer uses mutual induction changes from core displacements.

questions.question: Strain gauge is used to measure:
questions.hint: Resistance of foil strain gauge changes when subject to mechanical tension/compression.

questions.question: A pH sensor measures the concentration of:
questions.hint: pH is defined as the negative log of Hydrogen ion activity.

questions.question: What does PLC stand for in process control?
questions.hint: PLCs are ruggedized digital computers used for industrial automation.

questions.question: The gauge factor of a strain gauge is defined as the ratio of:
options: Fractional change in resistance to strain

questions.question: A thermocouple works on:
questions.hint: Seebeck effect generates voltage proportional to the junction temperature differences.

questions.question: Which instrument is used to measure fluid flow velocity using magnetic field?
questions.hint: Magnetic flowmeters use Faraday's law of induction on conductive fluids.

questions.question: In a control system, feedback is used to:
questions.hint: Negative feedback tracks setpoints and rejects external system disturbances.

questions.question: What is the unit of pressure?
questions.hint: Pascal (Pa) is equivalent to one Newton of force per square meter.

questions.question: An instrumentation amplifier has:
options: High CMRR and high input impedance
questions.hint: Differential layout guarantees high Common Mode Rejection Ratio (CMRR) and high impedance.

questions.question: The device used to convert physical variables into electrical signals is:
questions.hint: Transducers act as energy converters for signal conditioning circuits.

questions.question: Which sensor works on change in distance between plates?
questions.hint: Capacitance C is proportional to area A divided by distance d.

questions.question: A PID controller stands for:
questions.hint: PID loops use current error (P), past accumulative error (I), and rate of change (D).

questions.question: The damping ratio for an underdamped system is:
questions.hint: Underdamped systems decay with oscillations (damping ratio zeta < 1).
